mapper.sql: id, name, slug, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_tutorial_category (name, slug, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, COALESCE(t.tutorial_count, 0) AS tutorial_count, COALESCE(ch.chapter_count, 0) AS chapter_count FROM sr_tutorial_category c LEFT JOIN (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS tutorial_count FROM sr_tutorial GROUP BY category_id) t ON t.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.category_id, COUNT(*) AS chapter_count FROM sr_tutorial_chapter ch JOIN sr_tutorial t ON t.id = ch.tutorial_id GROUP BY t.category_id) ch ON ch.category_id = c.id ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_tutorial_category WHERE slug = #{slug}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_tutorial_category SET name = #{name}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sr_tutorial_category SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
